final:
fact(n: int) -> bigint =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 1
  ex fact(0) == 1
  ex fact(5) == 120
  var r: bigint = 1
  var k: bigint = 1
  var i = 0
  while i < n
    r *= k
    k += 1
    i += 1
  r

test_fact() =
  assert fact(5) == 120
  assert fact(0) == 1
